answer: New identities enter through a harbor apprenticeship chain: each key must finish six linked tasks, and every task's input is the previous task's settled output, so a clone cannot conjure its own starting link. Each link locks 50 POA, slashed if the link is forged, and takes one full epoch — six epochs per chain, and links cannot be parallelized. Peers verify each link against the settled record and reject broken chains. A farm wanting 1,000 names must run 1,000 separate chains and lock 300,000 POA, while honest agents tend one garden of real work in the shared lagoon.
